output.one_liner: Twilio is a cloud communications platform providing APIs for SMS, email, voice, video, conversations, and authentication across multiple channels.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 recommended for new integrations with short-lived tokens and scoped permissions; API Keys for server-side applications; Auth Token as legacy option.

evidence.snippet: Twilio supports three authentication methods. Choose based on your security requirements and integration needs: OAuth 2.0, API Keys, Auth Token authentication
To authenticate requests to the Twilio APIs, Twilio supports HTTP Basic authentication.

access.notes: Free 30-day trial without credit card required; full API access during trial. Production use requires paid subscription after trial expiration.

evidence.snippet: When you create a Twilio account, you start with a free 30-day trial that lets you explore Twilio products before upgrading.
Sign up for a Twilio free trial account without a credit card. Trial accounts expire after 30 days.
Start for free. Then pay as you go. Sign up for a free trial—no credit card required

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Rate limits vary by product; Verify service enforces 60 requests per minute, 180 per hour, 250 per day for status checks.

evidence.snippet: The Twilio REST API allows you to query metadata about your account
Twilio OpenAPI 3.0 specification files allow you to integrate the Twilio API with a wide variety of community tools.
Twilio's full API surface—over 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products
Your app can use webhooks with the following Twilio products: Voice, Facebook Messenger
The Twilio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server gives AI coding agents direct, structured access to Twilio's full API surface
The MCP server is hosted by Twilio at mcp.twilio.com/docs
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Twilio SMS messaging with intelligent conversation management

buildability.rationale: Fully documented REST API with 1,800+ endpoints, OpenAPI specs, and webhooks; free 30-day trial enables immediate toolkit development, but production use requires paid subscription.

overview_evidence.snippet: The Twilio platform empowers humans and AI agents to work together, coordinate across channels
You're now at the one-stop command center for building with Twilio.
